messages:
Alex: Handoff for 03/17 night -> morning. Quick update: seeing intermittent KV-cache latency spikes in eu-west-1 since ~02:15 UTC. Affects embeddings read path; error rate up ~1.8% and p50 latency from ~20ms -> ~180ms for small batch reads. Runbook actions taken: enabled extra cache replicas and turned on read-through fallback to long-term storage.

Priya: Mitigations done: scaled cache pool +2 nodes (autoscaler triggered, confirmed), enabled disk fallback (read-through), and applied temporary rate-limit for low-priority tenants to 50r/s. Cache node CPU now ~78%. Watching evictions.

Josh: Current alerts: alert-embed-read-latency firing (see dashboard link), but no SLO breach yet. Eviction spike earlier, now trending down. Open PR to adjust max_connections to reduce head-of-line waits: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342 (CI running).

Lina: Ran a quick smoke test against embeddings service: 100 requests -> 99 successes, 1 500 (disk fallback triggered). Snippet from logs:
```
2026-03-17T02:18:22Z cache_read: latency=184ms key=vec_abc123 fallback=true
```
Fallback=true indicates long-term read path used. Correlating request IDs and trace ids now.

Marco: Next steps I can own: merge PR after CI green, schedule a controlled pressure test at 04:30 UTC during lower traffic, and monitor for latency regressions. If latency persists post-merge, escalate to infra lead and consider rolling back config.

Alex: Anything blocking for morning oncall? If not, Priya will take 04:00->12:00 UTC shift.

Priya: I can take morning. I'll monitor dashboards and escalate if we see repeated fallback=true > 0.5% over 10m. @OpsBot please run preflight cache-health checks every 15m and post updates here. :eyes:

OpsBot: scheduled check-in every 15m starting 03/17T03:00Z; will post short status to this thread.

Josh: FYI I added notes to the runbook about interpreting disk fallback traces and the metric names to watch (cache.fallback.rate, cache.evictions.per_min). Also added debug query to quickly fetch recent fallback traces.

Lina: No blockers on my side. Full logs uploaded: s3://redwood-logs/eng-oncall/2390001234/ with request-ids in the runbook note.

Alex: TL;DR action items: Marco -> merge & run pressure test; Priya -> monitor + escalate as needed; Josh -> runbook update (done); Lina -> correlate logs and post any anomalous traces. I'll check in at 04:00 for status handoff. Thanks everyone.
